clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Rhahk'Zor drives the work forward by force. As head foreman, he keeps Defias laborers and miners in line while they build Edwin VanCleef's underground fortress.

The Defias Brotherhood has turned Moonbrook's abandoned gold mines into an underground fortress. Rhahk'Zor was appointed head foreman to coordinate the work. He oversees the excavation crews and laborers as they carve tunnels and build VanCleef's secret projects.

Rhahk'Zor keeps order with muscle and an immense stone-headed hammer. Defias diggers and goblin engineers know that defiance or falling behind schedule can bring a crushing blow from the towering foreman.
